setup.title: Pig's Tail Settings
setup.playerCountAppliesAfterReset: The selected player count will apply to the next game after reset.

drawGuidance.penalty: If you draw the same suit as the top center card, you take the whole center pile.
drawGuidance.emptyStock: The stock is empty, so the game is over. The player with the most cards in hand loses.

tutorial.circleArea: This is the circle pile. Cards are placed face down in a circle.
tutorial.centerArea: This is the center pile. Drawn cards are placed here.
tutorial.drawButton: Press this button to draw a card. If it matches the suit of the top center card, you get a penalty!
tutorial.playerArea: Each player's hand count is shown here.
tutorial.resetButton: Press reset to start a new game.

hint.draw: Your turn — draw a card from the circle.
hint.afterPenalty: Previous draw caused a penalty. Draw again.
